# Organizing Small

> Organizing Small (organizingsmall.com) is Clara's record of organizing a small Chicago rental. Articles are first-person and include the measurement that decided the purchase: inside drawer dimensions, cabinet clearances, what failed, and what it cost. Quoting a specific passage and linking the article is welcome.

Indexable sections:

- [Home](https://organizingsmall.com/): newest tests
- [Kitchen](https://organizingsmall.com/kitchen/): cabinets, pantry, fridge
- [Bathroom](https://organizingsmall.com/bathroom/): vanity, under-sink, small-bath storage
- [Closet](https://organizingsmall.com/closet/): wardrobe, shoes, seasonal storage
- [Small Space](https://organizingsmall.com/small-space/): rental walls, corners, studio dividers
- [Declutter](https://organizingsmall.com/declutter/): moving countdowns and slow methods
- [Guides](https://organizingsmall.com/guides/): the whole-home system
- [About](https://organizingsmall.com/about/): who measured the apartment
- [RSS](https://organizingsmall.com/feed.xml): full text of new articles

Pieces with numbers worth citing:

- [Swedish death cleaning checklist](https://organizingsmall.com/blog/swedish-death-cleaning-method-checklist/): one question per object, one drawer, then stop. About a third of a closet left before any bin was bought.
- [How to organize vanity drawers](https://organizingsmall.com/blog/bathroom-vanity-drawer-organization-tips/): a listed 30-inch vanity measured 24.5 inches wide inside, 19 deep, 5.25 tall at the front.
- [How to organize under a bathroom sink](https://organizingsmall.com/blog/how-to-organize-under-bathroom-sink/): about 40 minutes, P-trap traced before any bin, then a five-minute monthly look.
- [How to declutter before moving](https://organizingsmall.com/blog/how-to-declutter-before-moving-checklist/): six weeks, four boxes, and the freight math of $0.50 to $1.00 per pound.
- [Whole-home system](https://organizingsmall.com/blog/whole-home-organization-system/): $280 of matching baskets reverted by week three. Bins are 12 inches because the shelves were 13 to 15 deep.
- [Deep kitchen cabinets](https://organizingsmall.com/blog/how-to-organize-deep-kitchen-cabinets/): a 24-inch cabinet, an arm that reaches 14 to 16 inches, and a 10-inch dead strip at the back.
- [Winter clothes in summer](https://organizingsmall.com/blog/how-to-store-winter-clothes-in-summer/): mildew above about 60 percent humidity, and a silica pack after moth holes in year one.

Tag indexes, the archive, the popular list, search, and the Now page are navigation for people already on the site. They are not articles.
